description: Wiener Linien – Fahrplandaten GTFS Wien is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wienerlinien.at. Timetable and spatial data of stops in GTFS format (General Transit Feed Specification) Further information:. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Vienna Lines — Timetable data GTFS Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Autobus, Fahrpläne, Haltestellen, Abfahrzeiten, Fahrplan, Straßenbahn. The listing shows 6 download or service links in TXT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
